dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, I need help with my homework. Is anyone online?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, aɪ ˈniːd ˈhɛlp wɪð maɪ ˈhoʊmwɜːrk. ɪz ˈɛniwʌn ˌɑːnˈlaɪn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let me check the class chat. No one is online now. It's late!
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈklæs ˌtʃæt. ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn ɪz ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈnaʊ. ɪts ˈleɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! I have to give it to Mr. Brown tomorrow morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈɡɪv ɪt tə ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn təˈmɑːroʊ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Send a message to the group. Someone can help you in the morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɛnd ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ tə ðə ˈɡruːp. ˈsʌmwʌn kən ˈhɛlp juː ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea. Which app does everyone use?
dialogue.reading: ˌɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ˈwɪtʃ ˈæp dʌz ˈɛvriwʌn ˈjuːz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Everyone in our class uses this app. I'll add you to the group.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvriwʌn ɪn aʊər ˈklæs ˈjuːzɪz ðɪs ˈæp. aɪl ˈæd juː tə ðə ˈɡruːp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Oh, look! Someone is online now!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ˈoʊ, ˈlʊk! ˈsʌmwʌn ɪz ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈnaʊ!
